gate.status: XM_1's one-time read stopped in its holdout step (owner question XM1-Q1) with no holdout number written; its development selection was the incumbent, so xM$ is the served /fa/ market model

what.roster.xm_aav_usd: the sum of xM$ AAV (P50) over the club's 40-man rows, the market cost to replace them this winter; quantiles are never summed
what.roster.fair_aav_usd: the sum of Fair $ per year of the xM$ term over the same rows
what.roster.payroll_spotrac: Spotrac's figures, quoted beside the sum and never netted against it
what.market_surplus.xm_usd: sum over each player's priced control seasons of xM$ AAV carried by the $/WAR index minus the expected salary (contract, the arbitration ladder or the league minimum), discounted
what.market_surplus.fair_usd: the same seasons with each season's Fair $ in place of the xM$ leg
what.farm.xm_aav_usd: the sum of xM$ AAV over the club's board prospects off the 40-man
what.farm.xm_total_usd: the sum of their xM$ NPV guarantees
